confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the Coron context (small Palawan island town, diving and island-tour economy), not from live listings or a current price survey. Accommodation and drink anchors are the least certain; restaurant anchors are somewhat more reliable. The FX observation was taken from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page and I did not open the page or its F11.1 table directly, so it should be checked against the official RBA source.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on regional knowledge of other Philippine island tourism towns, mainly Palawan destinations such as El Nido and Puerto Princesa, with Coron priced somewhat below Boracay-level tourist pricing. No single comparable city was verified.
